Name: Ultravisor — Secured (internal user management)
Description: Ultravisor + ultravisor-auth-beacon running the built-in MemoryAuthProvider.  The web UI requires login; the in-app user management views (list / edit / password change) are visible because the provider implements `supportsUserManagement() === true`.  Default sign-in: admin / admin (override via UVAdminPassword to seed your own).  Good for local dev, smoke testing the full login flow, and demoing the user-admin UX without bringing up an external identity backend.

DataRoot.Description: Where Ultravisor + auth-beacon state persist on the host.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout. Ultravisor + auth-beacon are built from sibling checkouts at launch.

UVAdminPassword.Description: Admin password seeded into MemoryAuthProvider.  Username is `admin`.  Default is `admin` for dev; set something stronger for shared environments.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.
